blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Karapatan on Monday condemned the shooting of a pregnant member of the New People’s Army (NPA) by suspected military agents in Tagum City, Davao del Norte. Lawyer Maria Sol Taule, deputy secretary general of Karapatan, said the shooting of a certain Arnida Cuaton Maguiguilid on Sept. 19 was “a violation of international humanitarian law.” “The pregnant NPA member, also vulnerable due to her condition, clearly had hors de combat status,” she pointed out. “Despite this, she was shot in the back, which crippled her and endangered her unborn child as well.” Citing earlier local reports, Karapatan said Maguiguilid, […]...
